limitations: WorldCover 2021/retained OSM is historical planning evidence, not a current shoreline or site survey.
Twenty-metre cells do not resolve narrow streams, flooding, wetlands, scour, foundations or clearances.
Dry legacy bridges may represent unverified obstructions: retain a nonzero priced reserve or a hold.
Water mapping does not design a bridge or establish physical acceptance.
Historical satellite classification is an independent planning screen, not a current shoreline survey.
Narrow streams, inundation, wetlands, platform footprints, bank access and foundation stability require site evidence.

finance.formula: Annual boardings = sum(line peak flow × (1+reverse flow fraction) × service hours × profile weighted fraction × mean/peak section load ÷ average trip/line length × operating days × demand multiplier). Paid linked trips = boardings ÷ boardings per linked trip × collection fraction.
